selection.source_population: valid cm-land-conf-041 through cm-land-conf-100 physical/reference recordings
selection.selection_rule: Within each declared family, take the earliest valid source-order configurations until its quota is filled; do not use prior P/R outcomes or annotations.
selection.prior_status: All source recordings and earlier semantic outputs are inspected development material. New outputs cannot be confirmation.

promotion_questions: Are B2 and B4 packets information- and tool-parity complete?
Can two humans apply atomic labels and abstraction levels without method cues?
What B2-only and B4-only episode failures are plausible for sample-size planning?
What useful-coverage floor is scientifically defensible without matching a known B4 deficit?
Do any systematic contract, ladder, reference, or annotation defects require one final development repair?
prohibitions: Do not report pilot p-values as confirmation.
Do not choose the confirmatory endpoint from whichever pilot secondary metric looks best.
Do not retry a poor response, replace a valid episode, or count evidence conditions as independent samples.
Any method repair creates a new development version; this pilot remains immutable.
